headline: Egor Kornev Sets 50m Butterfly World Record
captionCards: New global standard for men's 50m butterfly
instagramCaption:
Egor Kornev has set a new world record in the men’s 50 butterfly.

The swimmer achieved a time of 21.28 seconds, establishing a new global standard for the event. This performance marks a significant milestone in competitive swimming history.
